# TestIRRetainedStdPopulationRuns). A line that leaves `ran` is a regression;

#   NOMI_REGENERATE_EXPECTATIONS=1 go test ./internal/irbuild -run '^TestIRRetainedStdPopulationRuns$' -count=1
